text: The Jacobi identity, one of the two defining axioms of the Lie bracket on a Lie algebra $\mathfrak{g}$, states that for all $X,Y,Z$:
explanation: The Jacobi identity is the vanishing cyclic sum $[X,[Y,Z]]+[Y,[Z,X]]+[Z,[X,Y]]=0$; it replaces associativity, which the bracket does NOT satisfy (choice 0). $[X,Y]=[Y,X]$ is symmetry, but the bracket is antisymmetric $[X,Y]=-[Y,X]$; and $[X,[X,Y]]=0$ is not a general axiom.
